rv.q: His willingness to allow his insecurities and awkwardness to stand in as the butt of these jokes is what elevates the show to a higher form of gallows humor.

Birbiglia has rapid eye movement sleep behavior disorder, which causes him to do things like cook dinner in his sleep. Oh, and at one point, to jump out of a second-floor motel window (“like the Hulk”) and end up with dozens of stitches.
Sometimes he succeeds and sometimes he doesn’t, depending on your expectations and your sense of humor.

cn.t: Birbiglia's meditation on mortality draws mixed reactions, with critics finding his comedic approach to death and illness uneven—sometimes landing, sometimes missing depending on one's humor—though the show remains engaging and funny throughout.
